label: predatory bacterium
definition: A trophic-ecology lifestyle in which a bacterium actively kills and consumes other bacteria for nutrients, e.g. the periplasmic predator Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus.
observations: Existing v5 parent ID and meaning; included for standalone hierarchy.

label: cytoplasmic bacterial predation
definition: A predatory bacterial phenotype in which a bacterium enters the cytoplasm of a bacterial prey cell and grows and reproduces there by consuming and degrading the prey cytoplasm.
observations: Prey-cytoplasmic invasion with destructive feeding and reproduction; not residence alone.
